title: UTAGE 模块闭环：有界放行恢复三个严格 XFAIL、修复文件系统假失败、补上表恢复情况、1099 行按 cell 归因
status: module execution and coverage triage complete; 35 documented RTL differences and several combination gaps remain open

coverage.honest_attribution: all +730 lines are the per-cell useful-allocation arm and its if-head (365+365), now executed because the 512x2 update matrix completes instead of aborting at the first high-tag address; no new function and no denominator change

bounded_allowance.why: the independent semantic reference detected three already-declared defects earlier than the scenario's own exception, so the strict markers no longer matched and the scenarios either reported ordinary FAIL or aborted at the first difference
api: allow_known_miss(pc, position): only an expected-hit/actual-miss at that exact logical address
allow_known_counter_difference(table, index): only the counter field of that exact cell
properties: event-set scoped, not a time window
only the declared field set is dropped; tag/position/base/other slots and cells are still compared
every use is recorded with tick, address/cell, expected/observed and reason
the scenario's own collector still decides the verdict and raises its declared exception

defects.BPU-UTAGE-007: tag width 8 bits in training/SRAM vs wider prediction tag; genuine allocated cell still checked
defects.BPU-UTAGE-016: ring-slot reuse clears the newly enqueued dirty entry; 112 failing cells retained and recorded
defects.BPU-UTAGE-021: 768 lower high-address provider contexts blocked by 007; full matrix now completes

harness_fix.symptom: FileNotFoundError on the per-case isolated output directory turned strict XFAIL into FAIL
harness_fix.cause: output_path().write_text() assumed the parent existed; the defect scenario writes evidence before raising
fix: bpuverify/common/pytest/managed.py and evidence.py create the per-case directory before the test
harness_fix.evidence: tests/framework/test_artifact_paths.py: 20 PASS; targeted 3-case run yields 3 XFAIL

new_case.distinction: the saved snapshot carried tableId=1 (upper provider), so replay cannot be satisfied by re-reading an equal lower entry; a changed overrideStartPc changes only hit, while direction still comes from the saved snapshot

uncovered_lines.audit: bpuverify/utage/coverage/useful_cell_audit.py: 1099/1099 matched, 0 unclassified, denominator unchanged, no functional credit
uncovered_lines.meaning: per-cell copies of one allocation/reward/penalty template for cells updated in only one direction

uncovered_branches.aging_note: one copy per (bank,set); 15 cells reached the decrement arm; BPU-UTAGE-017 verifies the semantics across 4 banks x 3 strengths

utage_dut_1133.semantic: saved upper-table provider supplies the taken bit for AheadBTB slot 2 in override
utage_dut_1133.probe: positions 6/7/8 x base 0/1 x S2/S3 did not select it

verified: A x B read/feedback same beat
B x C aging plus learning same beat
B x H ring wrap and same slot
open: io.redirect is a dead knob: model expresses it and RTL gates a2 hit vectors with ~io_redirect, but UtagePorts never binds it and no case drives it
single-port SRAM force-write/read same-bank conflict degrades a read to miss; the model does not express this
feedback with S2/S3 override on the same beat
aging with disable on the same beat

existing_failures.note: the four nodes that left the FAIL set are exactly the three strict XFAILs plus the allocation matrix that was blocked by 007

false_positive_false_negative_checks: 35 FAIL nodes are the exact baseline set; nothing was renamed, skipped or moved to XFAIL
the bounded allowance is negative-controlled for undeclared address, reverse difference, mixed fields, wrong cell and invalid declaration
the case-own collector still counts 112 failing cells for 016 and 768 blocked contexts for 021
coverage growth is attributed to per-cell allocation copies, not to new semantics
the 1099 rows are classified by exact templates and reject weakened source
the harness failure was fixed in the harness rather than by widening the strict marker
constraints: No RTL, DUT or system SDK change.
No internal signal writes and no VPI seeding.
